title: Replay model-visible inputs from a recorded manifest
narrative: Nubble starts the CLI host with family `pass_through` and backend `mock`. Nubble needs every model call to leave a reconstructible record of what the model saw — messages, tools, and instructions — so offline replay does not depend on hidden memory. Accepts WalkingLabs DeepSeek and P06 observability guidance. He walks product steps (replay_model_input) and verifies completion from the structured observation expects on this scenario. [^wl-deepseek-manifest][^wl-p06-manifest]
implementation: `ModelInputManifest` in `mechaharness.model_input_manifest` records messages, tool definitions, instructions, and content hashes; `reconstruct_messages` rebuilds the call without in-memory state. `CliInstrumentor` verb `replay_model_input` exposes this diagnostic. Decision records may reference the manifest via `context_manifest_ref`.
validation: Harness `user_story` scenario `manifest_replay.yaml`: environment + graph + steps + complete expects.
